tei:div.tei:p: bod du bla chen mkhan rgyud dang*/ spu tsho mkhan rgyud/paṇa chen mkhan rgyud rnams kyi byon tshul bzhugs so//

na mo bud+dha ya/ thub bstan gangs ri'i khrod du gsal mdzad pa'i/ /smad 'dul byung khung mkhan rgyud rim pa ni/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po thugs sras sha ri'i bu/ /sras mchog sgra gcan bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ /klu sgrub skyes mchog legs ldan dpal sbas dang*/ /ye shes snying po zhi ba 'tsho la 'dud/ /sbas ston rat+na gtsang ston rab gsal dang*/ /bla chen dgongs gsal shes rab seng ge dang*// byang chub gzhon nu byang chub rgyal mtshan te/ 'jad pa ston skyabs byang ston gzhon nu zhabs/ /rtsis 'dul chen po mkhan po bde ba dpal/ /byang sems rin mgon thogs med bzang po dpal/ /yon tan 'od sogs bla chen mkhan rgyud kyi/ /sdom brtson dam pa rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /bla chen mkhan rgyud ni/ rgyal sras thogs med pa nas rgyud pa 'di dag par byed par yod do/ /na mo dharma ya/ thub bstan gsal zhing stod 'dul rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /spu tsho mkhan rgyud byon pa'i rim pa ni/ thub dbang sha ri'i bu dang sgra gcan 'dzin// legs 'dom nag po pa dang dha ri ka /grags mchog legs skyong rgyal ba shes rab ste/ /mu gro 'dul 'dzin chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /byang sems zla rgyal dharma rgyal mtshan dang*/ /mnga' ris dgra bcom mkhan chen dbang phyug mdzes// mdzes pa 'od zer mdzes pa bzang po dang*/ /seng dpal kun mkhyen mdzes pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang*// shākya rgyal mtshan spu tsho mkhan rgyud kyi/ /bslab gsum rgyan ldan rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /spu tsho mkhan rgyud stod 'dul gyi byung khungs 'di/ gtsang g.yas ru 'u yug zam tshe ba la rgyud pa 'di dag par byed do// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/bla chen mkhan rgyud dang*/ spu tsho mkhan rgyud/ paṇa chen mkhan rgyud rnams byon tshul/ -PAGE 250--PAGE 269--PAGE 249-
